verdict.rationale: GitCafe's first-party webhooks doc says a webhook sends a signed HTTPS request to your server when repository or organization events occur, such as pushes, new issues or merged pull requests. That is a genuine outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer can receive. Missing for 10: full event catalog, registration/management details (UI or API), delivery retries/logs and signature verification specifics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
